description: Open Studio, a local page with a live PDF preview, to choose the page style, font, header, footer and logo. Saved choices apply to every later export. Use when the user wants to change how their PDFs look in general; for a one-off change, pass arguments to export_markdown_pdf instead.

file.description: Markdown file to preview instead of the built-in sample. Use an absolute path.

open_browser.description: Open Studio in the default browser. Default: true. The private link is returned either way.

project_folder.description: Edit the settings of this folder only (its .markdown-pdf.json) instead of the user settings used by every document. Use an absolute path.

name: open_studio_markdown_pdf
title: Open Markdown PDF Studio
